# Botpasses

> You store an API key once. An agent (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Grok, or any MCP client) calls the API through Botpasses over MCP; the key is attached inside the vault and does not enter the chat, the model, or the logs. Grant-vault, not zero-knowledge: the hosted process decrypts only at an approved inject.

MCP endpoint: https://botpasses.com/mcp (OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration on botpasses.com, or a console-issued bearer token). Primary tool: http_request. There is no get_secret.
